name: vayuindia
description: Vayu storefront and admin panel on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2

scripts.//split: The three-origin split. The storefront is still the monolith (wrangler.jsonc); api, admin and payments are standalone Workers.
scripts.dev:split: node scripts/build-workers.mjs && wrangler dev -c wrangler.admin.jsonc -c wrangler.api.jsonc -c wrangler.payments.jsonc --port 8793 --local
scripts.deploy:payments: node scripts/build-workers.mjs payments && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.payments.jsonc
scripts.deploy:api: node scripts/build-workers.mjs api && node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.api.jsonc
scripts.deploy:admin: node scripts/build-workers.mjs admin && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.admin.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.//snapshot: Rewrite the static fallback from the live shop before a deploy, so the prerendered pages ship with the catalogue as it actually is.
